name: avex-release-video
description: Avex 0.9 release video — 1920x1080 before/after cut, built from real device captures.

scripts.render: npm run render:picture && npm run render:audio && tools/deliver.sh out/avex-0.9-picture.mp4 out/avex-0.9.wav out/avex-0.9.mp4
scripts.render:4k: remotion render src/index.ts release out/avex-0.9-4k-picture.mp4 --overwrite --scale=2 --crf=18 && npm run render:audio && tools/deliver.sh out/avex-0.9-4k-picture.mp4 out/avex-0.9.wav out/avex-0.9-4k.mp4
